## Summary

I resolved ticket T-5004 by identifying that the ConfigMap update for the gateway rate limits had not propagated to the running pods' mounted volumes. The evidence came from the pod logs, which showed the file hash remaining constant since startup despite the ConfigMap being updated 2+ hours earlier. The recommended fix is to restart the API gateway deployment to force the pods to remount the ConfigMap with the updated rate limit of 500 rps for acme-logistics.
